question: U is the daughter in law of T. T is the paternal grandmother of K. T has only one son and one daughter I and J. I is the male member in the family. How is U related to J?
solution:
Symbol for family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba88205240559c9be20f20ddacac79b98b889a5a2ad51a5920e50f207f64f573.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93d1703a6e9a49356d8faaedca72f290894cfd223f50fde8cd6543f2ec4492a5.png] 

U is the sister in law of J.

Hence, “sister-in-law” is correct answer.
